$comment: Trust material. sha256 = SHA-256 of the DER file in certs/, uppercase hex. Taiwan roots (category government/private) are always trusted; international roots (category international, with vendor and usage signing/timestamping) only when the user turns on the international option. Re-verify against the listed sources before changing anything here, then run: node scripts/trust-store/build-trust-store.mjs
